Add a journal entry for finished work, a blocker, or a planned next step. Each entry can have tags, references, and details.

## CLI

### gournal add

Add a journal entry. Gournal records the project, repo, and branch of the current directory. A summary over 120 characters, or with a line break, is cut at the first sentence. The full text goes to details, and a note prints.

```text
gournal add <summary> [options]
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `<summary>` | yes | One line that says what happened. |

#### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Tag the entry. Separate tags with commas. | (empty) |
| `-d, --details <text>` | Save longer text with the entry. The summary stays one line. |  |
| `-k, --kind <kind>` | Set the entry kind: done (default), blocker, or next. | `done` |
| `--resolves <ids>` | Close the open blocker or next entries with these ids. Separate ids with commas. One unknown id stops the add, and gournal stores nothing. |  |

## MCP tool

### add_entry

Add a journal entry. Pass `project` explicitly whenever you know it, and pass `cwd` so that gournal can record the repo and branch. The server process's own working directory is not a reliable signal for which project the calling agent is actually in. Fields come from the explicit arguments first, then from `cwd`, then from the first client root, and last from the server's own cwd (only when `project` is omitted).

#### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `summary` | `string` | no | One line, max 120 characters. A longer summary is split into details when you pass `details`, or when you retry a summary with the same first 60 characters within 10 minutes. Otherwise the server rejects it. |
| `message` | `string` | no | Deprecated alias for summary. Use summary instead. |
| `details` | `string` | no | Longer text for this entry. Use it when the summary needs more room. |
| `kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | no | Entry kind: done (default), blocker (something stops you), or next (a planned step). Default: `"done"`. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Project name for this entry. Pass it explicitly. Do not rely on the server working directory. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Repository name, for example owner/name. |
| `branch` | `string` | no | Git branch name. |
| `cwd` | `string` | no | Your working directory. Gournal derives project, repo, and branch from it. |
| `agent` | `string` | no | Name of the calling agent. Gournal stores it with the entry. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Tags for this entry. Reuse existing tags (list_tags). |
| `refs` | `object[]` | no | References such as PRs and ticket keys. Put them here, not in tags. |
| `refs.type` | `"pr" \| "jira" \| "commit" \| "url"` | yes | Kind of reference: a PR, a Jira key, a commit, or a URL. |
| `refs.value` | `string` | yes | The PR number, ticket key, commit hash, or URL. |
| `refs.repo` | `string` | no | Repository (owner/name) of the PR or commit. |
| `resolves` | `string[]` | no | Ids of open blocker or next entries that this entry closes. Use the full id or the last 8 characters. The server drops an unknown id, and the result carries a note. |

#### Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry result](/gournal/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry-result).

## Examples

### CLI

Add an entry. Gournal prints the short id of the new entry.

```console
$ gournal add "Fix rounding error in invoice totals" -t bugfix,invoices -d "Totals were off by one cent when a discount applied after tax."
✓ Entry added! (53X22ZXF)
```

Add a blocker or a next item with `--kind`. Gournal takes the project, repo, and branch from the current directory.

```console
$ gournal add "Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging" -k blocker -t webhooks
✓ Entry added! (0MC5VPCQ)

$ gournal add "Add a regression test for tax rounding" -k next -t testing,invoices
✓ Entry added! (V91XZBEK)
```

### MCP

Log a finished piece of work. Pass `project` and `cwd`.

```json
{
  "summary": "Fix rounding error in invoice totals",
  "details": "Totals were off by one cent when a discount applied after tax.",
  "project": "billing-api",
  "cwd": "/Users/you/dev/billing-api",
  "tags": [
    "bugfix",
    "invoices"
  ],
  "refs": [
    {
      "type": "pr",
      "value": "412",
      "repo": "acme/billing-api"
    }
  ]
}
```

The text result:

```text
Entry YDZR73PK added to billing-api: Fix rounding error in invoice totals
```

The structured result:

```json
{
  "entry": {
    "id": "01M7FRCQ8GYQH7Z6X9YDZR73PK",
    "createdAt": "2026-11-15T14:04:47.248Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-11-15T14:04:47.248Z",
    "deletedAt": null,
    "deviceId": "01M7FRCQ7JDAH7AYES8A121Y7N",
    "summary": "Fix rounding error in invoice totals",
    "details": "Totals were off by one cent when a discount applied after tax.",
    "kind": "done",
    "status": null,
    "resolvedAt": null,
    "resolvedByEntryId": null,
    "project": "billing-api",
    "repo": "acme/billing-api",
    "branch": "fix/invoice-rounding",
    "source": "mcp",
    "agent": null,
    "tags": [
      "bugfix",
      "invoices"
    ],
    "refs": [
      {
        "type": "pr",
        "value": "412",
        "repo": "acme/billing-api"
      }
    ]
  },
  "notes": []
}
```
